def waittime():
    # 生成一个随机的等待时间，单位为秒
    wait_time = random.randint(1, 6)  # 随机数在1到10之间
    return wait_time
#处理高德地图数据
def handlerGDData(region,kw,source):
    page_num=20
    page_size=20
    keywords=parse.quote(kw)
    region=parse.quote(region)
    for page in range(page_num):
        shopDataList = []
        time.sleep(waittime())
        # 发起GET请求
        response = requests.get("https://restapi.amap.com/v5/place/text?key=aed3ea4c9ca7b60a3bb291908348a0ff&amp;keywords="+keywords+"&amp;types=&amp;region="+region+"&amp;page_size="+str(page_size)+"&amp;page_num="+str(page))
        if response.status_code == 200:
            jsondata = response.json()
            if jsondata["status"]=="1":
                if jsondata["pois"].__len__() &gt; 0:
                    for poi in jsondata["pois"]:
                        pname = poi["pname"]
                        cityname = poi["cityname"]
                        adname = poi["adname"]
                        name = poi["name"]
                        address = poi["address"]
                        location = poi["location"]
                        shopDataList.append([kw, cityname, name, address, '', location, pname, adname,source])
                        print(kw, pname, cityname, adname, name,address,location)
                    insertshopData(shopDataList)
                    print(shopDataList)
            else:
                print("返回失败：结果"+response.text)
                break
        else:
            print("请求失败，状态码："+response.status_code)

    provinces = data["data"]["cityData"]["provinces"]

    for item in provinces:
        if provinces[item]["name"] == "台湾":
            continue
        if provinces[item]["name"] == "香港":
            continue
        if provinces[item]["name"] == "澳门":
            continue
        cities = provinces[item]["cities"]
        if cities.__len__() &gt; 0:
            for cityitem in cities:
                cityname = cityitem["name"]
                handlerGDData(cityname, keywords,source)
        else:
            province = provinces[item]["name"]
            handlerGDData(province, keywords,source)
#腾讯地图 垃圾地图，限制接口返回数量200，分页也不行
def handlerTXData(region,kw,source):
    shopDataList = []
    page_num = 1
    page_size = 20
    keywords = parse.quote(kw)
    region = parse.quote(region)
    key="RYFBZ-ZKXWZ-CM4XK-ZTLHC-A4U22-FTFR6"
    url = "https://apis.map.qq.com/ws/place/v1/search?boundary=region("+region+",0)&amp;keyword="+keywords+"&amp;page_size="+str(page_size)+"&amp;page_index="+str(page_num)+"&amp;key="+key
    time.sleep(waittime())
    response = requests.get(url)
    if response.status_code == 200:
        jsondata = response.json()
        if jsondata["status"] == 0:
            count=jsondata["count"]
            print(count)
            if count &gt; 0:
                page_num=math.ceil(count/page_size)
                print(page_num)
                if(page_num&gt;1):
                    for page in range(2,page_num+1):
                        page_num=page
                        url1 = "https://apis.map.qq.com/ws/place/v1/search?boundary=region(" + region + ",0)&amp;keyword=" + keywords + "&amp;page_size=" + str(
                            page_size) + "&amp;page_index=" + str(page_num) + "&amp;key=" + key
                        time.sleep(waittime())
                        response1 = requests.get(url1)
                        if response1.status_code == 200:
                            jsondata1 = response1.json()
                            if jsondata1["status"] == 0:
                                datas= jsondata1["data"]
                                for item in datas:
                                    name=item["title"]
                                    address=item["address"]
                                    tel=item["tel"]
                                    lat=item["location"]["lat"]
                                    lng=item["location"]["lng"]
                                    location=str(lng)+','+str(lat)
                                    pname=item["ad_info"]["province"]
                                    cityname=item["ad_info"]["city"]
                                    adname=item["ad_info"]["district"]

                                    shopDataList.append([kw, cityname, name, address, tel, location, pname, adname,source])
                                    print(kw, pname, cityname, adname, name, address,tel, location)
                                print(shopDataList)
                                insertshopData(shopDataList)
                                shopDataList = []


                else:
                    if jsondata["status"] == 0:
                        datas = jsondata["data"]
                        for item in datas:
                            name = item["title"]
                            address = item["address"]
                            tel = item["tel"]
                            lat = item["location"]["lat"]
                            lng = item["location"]["lng"]
                            location = lng + ',' + lat
                            pname = item["ad_info"]["province"]
                            cityname = item["ad_info"]["city"]
                            adname = item["ad_info"]["district"]
                        shopDataList.append([kw, cityname, name, address, tel, location, pname, adname,source])
                        print(kw, pname, cityname, adname, name, address, location)
                    print(shopDataList)
                    insertshopData(shopDataList)
                    shopDataList = []




        else:
            print("返回失败：结果" + response.text)

    source = "腾讯"
    data = json.loads(jsonstr)
    provinces = data["p"]
    index = 1
    for item in provinces:
        province = item["prov"]["name"]
        if province == "台湾" or province == "特别行政区":
            continue
        citys = item["citys"]
        if citys.__len__() &gt; 0:
            for itemcity in citys:
                print(itemcity)
                # if itemcity=="邯郸":
                handlerTXData(itemcity, keywords,source)
        else:
            print(province)

#百度地图数据处理
def handlerBDData(region,kw,source):
    shopDataList = []
    page_num = 0
    page_size = 20
    keywords = parse.quote(kw)
    region = parse.quote(region)
    key="1wjBNGITQ2rRwoagbqWn95Vz"
    url = "https://api.map.baidu.com/place/v2/search?query="+keywords+"&amp;tag=&amp;region="+region+"&amp;output=json&amp;ak="+key+"&amp;page_num="+str(page_num)+"&amp;page_size="+str(page_size)
    time.sleep(waittime())
    response = requests.get(url)
    if response.status_code == 200:
        jsondata = response.json()
        if jsondata["status"] == 0:
            count=jsondata["total"]
            print(count)
            if count &gt; 0:
                page_num=math.ceil(count/page_size)
                print(page_num)
                if page_num&gt;1 :
                    for page in range(page_num):
                        page_num=page
                        url1 = "https://api.map.baidu.com/place/v2/search?query="+keywords+"&amp;tag=&amp;region="+region+"&amp;output=json&amp;ak="+key+"&amp;page_num="+str(page_num)+"&amp;page_size="+str(page_size)
                        time.sleep(waittime())
                        response1 = requests.get(url1)
                        if response1.status_code == 200:
                            jsondata1 = response1.json()
                            if jsondata1["status"] == 0:
                                datas= jsondata1["results"]
                                for item in datas:
                                    name=item["name"]
                                    address=item["address"]
                                    tel=item["telephone"]
                                    lat=item["location"]["lat"]
                                    lng=item["location"]["lng"]
                                    location=str(lng)+','+str(lat)
                                    pname=item["province"]
                                    cityname=item["city"]
                                    adname=item["area"]

                                    shopDataList.append([kw, cityname, name, address, tel, location, pname, adname,source])
                                    print(kw, pname, cityname, adname, name, address,tel, location)
                                print(shopDataList)
                                insertshopData(shopDataList)
                                shopDataList = []


                else:
                    if jsondata["status"] == 0:
                        datas = jsondata["results"]
                        for item in datas:
                            name = item["name"]
                            address = item["address"]
                            tel = item["telephone"]
                            lat = item["location"]["lat"]
                            lng = item["location"]["lng"]
                            location = str(lng) + ',' + str(lat)
                            pname = item["province"]
                            cityname = item["city"]
                            adname = item["area"]
                            shopDataList.append([kw, cityname, name, address, tel, location, pname, adname,source])
                            print(kw, pname, cityname, adname, name, address, location)
                    print(shopDataList)
                    insertshopData(shopDataList)
                    shopDataList = []




        else:
            print("返回失败：结果" + response.text)

    data = json.loads(jsonstr)
    # 解析百度json获取一级省市，不带pid的，默认一级
    provinces = [d for d in data if 'pid' not in d]
    # 再拿到带父id的子节点，后边要用，带一级的话报错
    childrencitys = [d for d in data if 'pid' in d]
    # 可排序按照json字段
    # sorted_records = sorted(provinces, key=lambda x: x['idx'])
    index = 1
    for item in provinces:
        province = item["name"]
        id = item["id"]
        if province == "台湾" or province == "香港" or province == "澳门":
            continue
        citys = [d for d in childrencitys if d['pid'] == id]
        if citys.__len__() &gt; 0:
            for itemcity in citys:
                cityname = itemcity["name"]
                # if itemcity=="邯郸":
                handlerBDData(cityname, keywords, source)
        else:
            print(province)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    BDditu()
    #GDditu()
    #TXditu()
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　可以模拟分页采集，禁止滥用，仅供研究</p>
